exams.name: Written examination for responsible broker / associate broker / salesperson license
exams.notes: Examination for responsible broker and associate broker is more exacting than for salesperson; salesperson exam covers business ethics, composition, arithmetic, elementary principles of land economics and appraisal, general knowledge of Wyoming statutes.

exams.quote: each applicant desiring to become licensed as a real estate responsible broker, associate broker or a real estate salesperson shall execute and file an application for examination upon a form prescribed by the commission and shall pass a written examination prepared by or under the supervision of the commission

interval_years.quote: Licenses issued under this act may be renewed for successive three (3) year periods.

available.quote: A nonresident may be issued a Wyoming responsible broker's license if: (i) The individual holds a like-license in his home state

requirements.value: Nonresident must hold a like-license in their home state, be actively engaged in the real estate business and maintain a place of business in their home state, meet all other Wyoming requirements, and furnish a statement under seal of the home state commission evidencing active license in good standing with no complaints pending.
requirements.quote: A nonresident may be issued a Wyoming responsible broker's license if: (i) The individual holds a like-license in his home state; (ii) The individual is actively engaged in the real estate business and maintains a place of business in his home state; (iii) The individual meets all the other requirements of this act and rules and regulations of the commission; and (iv) The individual furnishes the commission a statement under seal of the commission of his home state evidencing that he is an active licensed responsible broker, or an equivalent, in good standing and has no complaints pending against him in his home state.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting the breach of a listing or a property management contract

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conducting real estate activity directly with a buyer or seller knowing they have an outstanding written agreement with another responsible broker
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conducting real estate activity directly with a buyer or seller if the licensee knows the buyer or seller has an outstanding written agreement in connection with the real estate with another responsible broker

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using advertising which is misleading or inaccurate in any matter material to the transaction, or uses unauthorized marks/logos
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using advertising which: (A) Is misleading or is inaccurate in any matter material to the transaction; or (B) Uses a trade name, collective membership mark, service mark or logo name, mark or logo without authorization owned by another person unless authorized to do so.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Placing a sign on any property offering it for sale or rent without the written consent of the owner or authorized agent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Placing a sign on any property offering it for sale or rent without the written consent of the owner or his authorized agent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering real estate for sale or lease without the knowledge and consent of the owner or on unauthorized terms
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering real estate for sale or lease without the knowledge and consent of the owner or his authorized agent or on terms other than those authorized by the owner or his authorized agent

disciplinary_grounds.description: If a responsible broker, failing to supervise the activities of his associate broker or salesperson
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If a responsible broker, failing to supervise the activities of his associate broker or salesperson

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to advise the buyer and seller of all terms of the proposed sale including estimated discounts and closing costs at the time an offer is presented
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to advise the buyer and seller of all terms of the proposed sale at the time an offer is presented including estimated discounts and closing costs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unreasonably failing upon demand to surrender to the rightful owner any document or instrument in licensee's possession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unreasonably failing upon demand to surrender to the rightful owner, any document or instrument in his possession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unreasonably failing to produce documents of record concerning a real estate transaction under investigation by the commission
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unreasonably failing to produce documents of record in his possession or under his control concerning any real estate transaction under investigation by the commission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to submit all offers to a seller or buyer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to submit all offers to a seller or buyer

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commingling the money or other property of others with licensee's own
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commingling the money or other property of others with his own

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting, giving or charging an undisclosed compensation, rebate or direct or indirect profit on expenditures made for others
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting, giving or charging an undisclosed compensation, rebate or direct or indirect profit on expenditures made for others

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in real estate activity as an associate broker or salesperson involving representing a responsible broker or company other than the one under which he is licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in real estate activity as an associate broker or salesperson involving the representing or attempt to represent a responsible broker other than his responsible broker or a real estate company other than the real estate company under which he is licensed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting compensation by an associate broker or salesperson from anyone other than his responsible broker
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting compensation by an associate broker or salesperson from anyone other than his responsible broker

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without the written acknowledgement of all parties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting for more than one (1) party in a transaction without the written acknowledgement of all parties for whom the licensee acts

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guaranteeing or authorizing any person to guarantee future profits from the resale of real estate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Guaranteeing or authorizing any person to guarantee future profits which may result from the resale of real estate

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to obtain written listing agreements identifying the property and containing all required terms, signatures, and a definite expiration date
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to obtain written listing agreements identifying the property to be sold or acquired and containing all terms and conditions under which the property is to be sold or acquired including the price or price range, the compensation to be paid, the signatures of all parties concerned and a definite expiration date

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to deliver within a reasonable time a completed copy of any document to all parties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to deliver within a reasonable time a completed copy of any document to all parties

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony relating to real estate activity or duties of a licensee, or any felony sexual offense or violent crime
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony that relates to the practice of real estate activity or to the ability to perform the duties of a licensee or any felony sexual offense or violent crime

disciplinary_grounds.description: Compensating any unlicensed person for performing real estate activity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Compensating any unlicensed person for performing real estate activity

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to specify he is being compensated by more than one (1) party and failing to notify all parties involved

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to account for any monies or property received from others

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to keep the funds of others in an escrow or trust account, unless each person with an interest in the funds has agreed otherwise in writing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to deposit all financial instruments in an escrow or trust account within one banking day unless parties agree otherwise
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to deposit all financial instruments in an escrow or trust account within one (1) banking day in a financial institution in this state, unless each person with an interest in the funds has agreed otherwise in writing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing upon consummation or termination of the transaction to give a full accounting of monies and property in escrow or trust
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing upon consummation or termination of the transaction to give a full accounting of the monies and property placed in escrow or trust showing dates of deposit, management and withdrawals

disciplinary_grounds.description: If a responsible broker, failing to deliver a complete closing statement, retain copies, or disclose names of all real estate companies
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If a responsible broker: (A) Failing to deliver to the parties in every real estate transaction at the time the transaction is closed a complete, detailed closing statement showing all of the receipts and disbursements handled by the licensees in his office for the parties unless a clear and accurate accounting is furnished by another real estate licensee or a funds holder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing to any lender, guaranteeing agency or other interested party a false amount in excess of the true sale price or terms differing from those agreed upon
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing to any lender, guaranteeing agency or any other interested party, either verbally or through the preparation of false documents, an amount in excess of the true and actual sale price of the real estate or terms differing from those actually agreed upon

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting other than cash as earnest money without communicating the fact to the owner prior to acceptance and showing it in the earnest money receipt
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting other than cash as earnest money unless: (A) The fact is communicated to the owner prior to the owner's acceptance of the offer to purchase; and (B) The fact is shown in the earnest money receipt.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to appear or testify under oath at any hearing held by the commission
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to appear or testify under oath at any hearing held by the commission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receiving more than three censures from the commission within a two-year period
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Receiving more than three (3) censures from the commission within a two (2) year period.

insurance_required.quote: All licensees shall obtain and maintain errors and omissions insurance coverage under the group program or individual coverage.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Each resident responsible broker shall lawfully establish at least one (1) but no more than three (3) real estate companies or sole proprietorships within Wyoming and acquire a license for each real estate company.

definition_quote.quote: "Real estate activity" occurs when an individual for another and for compensation performs any one or more of the following: (A) Sells, exchanges, purchases, rents, manages or leases real estate

inactive_license_max_years.quote: A license on inactive status for more than three (3) years shall not be reissued on an active status unless the licensee has first met the educational requirements under subsection (b) of this section.

agency_relationship_types.quote: a licensee, with permission of the licensee's responsible broker, may act in any real estate transaction as an agent or intermediary or may work with the seller or buyer as a customer

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: A licensee shall not establish dual agency with any seller or buyer.

designated_agency_permitted.quote: "Designated licensee" means a licensee who is designated in writing by a responsible broker to serve as an agent for a seller or a buyer or as an intermediary in a real estate transaction

transaction_licensee_role_permitted.quote: "Intermediary" means a licensee who assists one (1) or more parties throughout a contemplated real estate transaction without acting as an agent or advocate for any party to the transaction

initial_interview_disclosure_required.quote: Prior to engaging in any discussion or arrangement incidental to a sale, purchase, exchange or lease of real estate, and, prior to entering into any written agreement with a buyer or seller, a licensee shall make a written disclosure of applicable agency, intermediary or customer relationships

written_service_agreement_required.quote: When engaged in any real estate activity, a licensee may act as an agent only pursuant to a written agreement with the seller or buyer which discloses the duties and responsibilities set forth in W.S. 33-28-303 or 33-28-304.

listing_contract_termination_date_requir.quote: Failing to obtain written listing agreements identifying the property to be sold or acquired and containing all terms and conditions under which the property is to be sold or acquired including the price or price range, the compensation to be paid, the signatures of all parties concerned and a definite expiration date

transaction_record_retention_years.quote: The records shall be maintained not less than two (2) years from the latest date on which the real estate company participated in the transaction.

escrow_account_required.quote: Maintain an account in a financial institution in this state designated as a trust or escrow account in which all down payments, earnest money deposits, advance listing fees or other trust funds received by him, his associate brokers or his salespersons on behalf of a principal or any other person shall be deposited unless all persons having an interest in the funds have agreed otherwise in writing.

escrow_deposit_deadline_business_days.quote: Failing to deposit all financial instruments in an escrow or trust account within one (1) banking day in a financial institution in this state, unless each person with an interest in the funds has agreed otherwise in writing

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: No responsible broker shall permit an advance payment of funds belonging to others to be deposited in the responsible broker's personal account or be commingled with his personal funds.

fixed_office_required.quote: Each resident responsible broker shall maintain a fixed principal office for each company or sole proprietorship within this state.

branch_office_associate_broker_required.quote: Every branch office shall be under the direction and supervision of the responsible broker.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: An associate broker or salesperson shall not be associated or engaged under contract to any other responsible broker than is designated upon the license issued to the associate broker or salesperson.

recovery_fund_exists.quote: If the commission is required to make any payment from the real estate recovery account in settlement of a claim or toward the satisfaction of a judgment, the commission shall immediately suspend the judgment debtor's license.

broker_price_opinion_permitted.quote: A licensee may prepare a broker's price opinion: (i) To a potential seller or third party, recommending a listing price of real estate; (ii) To a potential buyer or third party, recommending a purchase price of real estate; or (iii) To any third party, for any purpose permitted by law.

license_exemptions.quote: The provisions of this act shall not apply to: (i) An owner of real estate or to a member of his immediate family or to his regular employees with respect to property owned by him unless the owner, his immediate family or regular employee is a licensee
